title: Semantic Profiler Repository Profile
description: Declarative per-repository calibration, architectural layer rules, and CI budget thresholds for semantic-profiler.

domain_vocabulary.description: Domain-specific terms surfaced in CRW handoff packets to orient reviewers.

cohesive_data_globs.description: Glob patterns for cohesive static data/lookup tables dampened from hotspot scoring (unless they contain blanket suppressions).

flat_dispatcher_globs.description: Glob patterns for shallow exhaustive match/opcode dispatchers dampened from hotspot scoring (when max_nesting_depth <= 3 and no blanket suppressions).

test_globs.description: Additional glob patterns classified as test files and excluded from production hotspot, topology, and write-sink metrics.

ignore_globs.description: Glob patterns for directories or files excluded completely from discovery.

layers.description: Ordered architectural layers/strata from highest (entry/CLI/API) to lowest (storage/core). Mutually exclusive with the 'strata' alias.

strata.description: Alias for 'layers'. Do not specify both 'layers' and 'strata' in the same file.

allowed_edges.description: Explicit allow-list of cross-layer dependencies. When non-empty, cross-layer edges into non-leaf modules outside this list are flagged as declared_stratum_violation.

forbidden_bypasses.description: Explicit deny-list of cross-layer shortcuts flagged as declared_forbidden_bypass.

budgets.description: Optional CI/linter thresholds evaluated by `semantic-profiler check` and `semantic-profiler delta --fail-on-budget`.

globs.description: One or more non-empty repository-relative globs matching files in this layer.

from.description: Source layer name (must match a declared entry in layers/strata).

to.description: Destination layer name (must match a declared entry in layers/strata).

max_hotspot_score.description: Maximum allowed dampened hotspot_score for any single production file (finite, non-negative, or null).

max_prod_fn_loc.description: Maximum allowed lines of code for any single production function in an undampened file (or null).

max_blanket_suppressions.description: Maximum allowed blanket lint suppressions across production files (or null).

max_scc_count.description: Maximum allowed circular dependency clusters (Tarjan SCCs with |SCC| >= 2) across production files (or null).

max_bypass_count.description: Maximum allowed layer/facade bypasses, shortcut triangles, and cross-boundary reach-ins (or null).

max_smeared_write_count.description: Maximum allowed persistent write targets mutated by two or more distinct production modules (or null).

max_phantom_coupling_count.description: Maximum allowed production file pairs that co-change >= 2 times in git history without a direct import or mod edge (or null).
